desc: The Sun Optics RAID pistol dot is a compact sight that is ready for action. The wide lens and thin frame provide a wide-open and unobstructed sight picture while the bright 6MOA dot presents a crisp, precise aiming point. The design of the body is designed to help deflect minor bumps and bangs away from the lens protecting the glass and special coatings that offer a very clear, and night vision compatible, viewing plane.
